zh-CN.releaseNotes:
What's Changed
- [6236] 修复列表内插入表格后缺少插入列选项 by @PinkMagicFly in https://github.com/MoganLab/mogan/pull/4769
- [6235] 修复 bridge_argument_rep::notify_change 空指针解引用导致的闪退 by @PinkMagicFly in https://github.com/MoganLab/mogan/pull/4768
- [6237] 修复绘制图形模式下矩形边框线无法设置为虚线的问题 by @PinkMagicFly in https://github.com/MoganLab/mogan/pull/4770
- [6239] 修复页间隙出现白色横条 by @da-liii in https://github.com/MoganLab/mogan/pull/4772
- [200_38] 升级 macOS runner 至 macos-15 by @da-liii in https://github.com/MoganLab/mogan/pull/4774
- [6030] 修复大纲侧边栏跳转后回车编辑导致渐进排版丢失后续页面 by @PinkMagicFly in https://github.com/MoganLab/mogan/pull/4775
- [6031] 修复渐进式排版分块中嵌套 document 结构未渲染缺陷 by @PinkMagicFly in https://github.com/MoganLab/mogan/pull/4776
- [6240] 统一大纲侧边栏底色与工具栏底色 by @da-liii in https://github.com/MoganLab/mogan/pull/4777
- [6240] 移除大纲侧边栏右侧分割线并支持悬停调节宽度 by @da-liii in https://github.com/MoganLab/mogan/pull/4778
- [6241] 修复隐藏状态启动时无法通过底部页码按钮展开大纲侧边栏 by @da-liii in https://github.com/MoganLab/mogan/pull/4779
- [6240] 大纲侧边栏顶部标题由 Contents 改为 Outline 并增加中文翻译 by @da-liii in https://github.com/MoganLab/mogan/pull/4781
- [6240] CD on Debian 13：预装 python3-pip 与 aqtinstall，修复 Config 失败 by @PinkMagicFly in https://github.com/MoganLab/mogan/pull/4782
Full Changelog: https://github.com/MoganLab/mogan/compare/v2026.3.8...v2026.3.9
